Market today: The mood is cautious. The real driver is rising bond yields, which are rebounding and could put pressure on your tech and chip names, making future earnings look less attractive.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.56%) and SPAL (-40%) are both leveraged ETFs showing deep losses and are flagged for SELL/NEW. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-11.86%) and QQQI (-3.67%) are also flagged for TRIM and are nearing their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements. Also, monitor your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) closely for further decay and volatility.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with rising yields.
plays: SOXL: Given the SELL status, -52.56% loss, and leveraged decay, consider reducing exposure or tightening your stop from 200.
SPAL: This new leveraged position is already down -40%. Respect the 21.38 stop or consider cutting losses given its volatility and decay.
SMH: With a TRIM status and -11.86% loss, watch the 540 stop closely. Be ready to act if it breaks.
